QuestInfo.name: Ranger
QuestInfo.0: Ask Rene about becoming a Ranger.
QuestInfo.1: To become a Ranger, you must touch the Holy Stone at the Holy Ground in the Snowfield. You can get there from #rSharp Cliff I#k.\n\n#i4031059##t4031059# #b#c4031059# / 1#k

0.0: The test itself is simple. You must go to a certain place, defeat the enemy there, and bring the loot of battle back to me. This enemy, however... You'll have to see for yourself.
0.1: Go to the #bHoly Ground at the Snowfield#k. There, you will find a #bHoly Stone#k that will send you to another dimension. If you search Sharp Cliff I carefully, you'll find your way to the holy ground.
0.2: Your enemy's appearance may surprise you, but don't let that stop you. Defeat it and prove your true strength.\r\n#b(You will be moved to the Holy Ground at the Snowfield if you accept.)#k

no.0: I guess you're not ready, after all...
